svg.data-weight: 8.8 kg (19.4 lbs) (guide Table 1); the data sheet says 20 lbs (9.1 kg)
svg.data-size-over-ears: 48.3 x 4.4 x 40.6 cm (19 x 1.75 x 16 in) with the mounting ears (guide Table 1)
svg.data-ports-max-speed: 32 ports of 100 Gbps; 64 of 50 Gbps; 32 of 40 Gbps; 128 of 25 Gbps; 129 of 10 Gbps; 2 of 1 Gbps
svg.data-power-measure: guide Table 4 typical and maximum, conditions not stated; the data sheet prints 168 W / 343 W, typical measured at 25 C ambient with 50 percent load on all ports, excluding transceivers
svg.data-storage-temp: -25 to 70 C (guide Table 2); the data sheet says -40 to 70 C
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100G, 50G, 40G, 25G and 10G with breakout, in the 32 QSFP cages (data sheet)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G, in the two SFP+ cages (data sheet)
svg.data-console: RJ-45 RS-232 serial on the front
svg.data-oob: one 10/100/1000 management port on the front
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the front
svg.data-certifications: BSMI, CE, KCC, NRTL, RCM, UKCA, VCCI, TEC, ANATEL, ICASA, NOM Equivalency (data sheet)
